system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Monitoring alert policy that pages the on-call team when a Cloud Run service's 95th-percentile latency exceeds 500 ms for 5 minutes.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Monitoring alert policy that pages the on-call team when a Cloud Run service's 95th-percentile latency exceeds 500 ms for 5 minutes.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
  - path: alert-policy.jinja

resources:
  - name: oncall-notification-channel
    type: gcp-types/monitoring-v3:projects.notificationChannels
    properties:
      type: pagerduty
      displayName: On-Call PagerDuty
      description: PagerDuty notification channel for on-call team paging
      enabled: true
      labels:
        service_key: $(ref.pagerduty-service-key)
      userLabels:
        team: on-call
        severity: critical

  - name: cloudrun-p95-latency-alert
    type: gcp-types/monitoring-v3:projects.alertPolicies
    properties:
      displayName: "Cloud Run - P95 Latency > 500ms (5m)"
      documentation:
        content: |
          The 95th-percentile request latency for the Cloud Run service has
          exceeded 500ms over a 5-minute window.

          Runbook:
            1. Check Cloud Run revision health and recent deployments.
            2. Review error logs and traces in Cloud Trace.
            3. Inspect upstream dependency latency (DB, APIs).
            4. Consider rolling back the most recent revision if correlated.

          Dashboards:
            - https://console.cloud.google.com/run
            - https://console.cloud.google.com/monitoring
        mimeType: text/markdown
      combiner: OR
      enabled: true
      severity: CRITICAL
      notificationChannels:
        - $(ref.oncall-notification-channel.name)
      alertStrategy:
        autoClose: 1800s
        notificationRateLimit:
          period: 300s
      conditions:
        - displayName: "Cloud Run P95 request latency > 500ms for 5 minutes"
          conditionThreshold:
            filter: >-
              metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_latencies"
              AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision"
            comparison: COMPARISON_GT
            thresholdValue: 500
            duration: 300s
            evaluationMissingData: EVALUATION_MISSING_DATA_INACTIVE
            aggregations:
              - alignmentPeriod: 60s
                perSeriesAligner: ALIGN_PERCENTILE_95
                crossSeriesReducer: REDUCE_MEAN
                groupByFields:
                  - resource.label.service_name
                  - resource.label.location
            trigger:
              count: 1
      userLabels:
        managed-by: deployment-manager
        team: on-call
        severity: critical
        service: cloud-run

outputs:
  - name: alertPolicyName
    value: $(ref.cloudrun-p95-latency-alert.name)
  - name: notificationChannelName
    value: $(ref.oncall-notification-channel.name)
